# discord_channel (Data Source)

Fetches a single Discord channel by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_channel" "general" {
  channel_id = "456789012345678901"
}

output "general_name" {
  value = data.discord_channel.general.name
}

output "general_role_overwrites" {
  value = data.discord_channel.general.permissions.role_overwrites
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the channel.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Snowflake ID of the parent category, if any.
- `name` (String) Channel name.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is marked NSFW.
- `permissions` (Attributes) The channel's permission overwrites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `position` (Number) Position of the channel.
- `server_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild the channel belongs to.
- `topic` (String) Channel topic.
- `type` (Number) Channel type id.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `role_overwrites` (Attributes Map) Overwrites for roles, keyed by snowflake. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--role_overwrites))
- `user_overwrites` (Attributes Map) Overwrites for users, keyed by snowflake. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--user_overwrites))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions--role_overwrites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions.role_overwrites`

Read-Only:

- `allow` (Set of String) Allowed permission keys.
- `allow_bits` (String) Allowed permissions as a decimal bitfield.
- `deny` (Set of String) Denied permission keys.
- `deny_bits` (String) Denied permissions as a decimal bitfield.


<a id="nestedatt--permissions--user_overwrites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions.user_overwrites`

Read-Only:

- `allow` (Set of String) Allowed permission keys.
- `allow_bits` (String) Allowed permissions as a decimal bitfield.
- `deny` (Set of String) Denied permission keys.
- `deny_bits` (String) Denied permissions as a decimal bitfield.
